## ✨ Highlights

- 🔁 **An update says what it installs, and a node says what its other slot holds**: the Controller's Update page names the release it installs - in red, and only with its version typed, when it is older than the node's -, the node says the release of the bundle before writing it, and `janusctl version` and the node page show the release in the slot an update writes over and a rollback boots.
- 🗂️ **The event log survives reboots and updates**: a node keeps its last thousand events, so what happened before an update - or before a revert - is still there after it.

## 🔁 Updates

- **The node page's Update names what it installs**: the latest release, a pre-release or a prepared image is named above the form, in the confirmation's title and on its button. One older than the release the node runs is flagged in red, and installing it takes its version typed - going back stays possible, never by accident. **Use this update** is offered only for a newer release.
- **The node says what it installs**, before writing anything: `rootfs.squashfs: Janus v2026.10.13-5 (schematic a055fbb6)`, with `older than the … this node runs` when it is, then `rebooting into slot B (Janus v…)`. On the Controller's page, the toast says it; `janusctl lifecycle upgrade` prints it.
- **The other slot**: `janusctl version` has `Other slot: A - v2026.10.13-4, schematic …, HAProxy …, kernel …`, and the node page's Update › This node an **Other slot** line - the release an update writes over, and the one a rollback boots; the installation's confirmation names what it replaces. Read off the slot itself: an image from before v2026.10.06-3 says it doesn't know.

## 🗂️ Event log

- **Kept on the node** (STATE): its last thousand events come through janusd's restarts, the node's reboots and its updates - a revert included -, IDs going on. Written to disk within 5 seconds, and before every reboot. A Reset wipes it, with the rest of STATE.
- **Each start of janusd** is the first event of its run, with the release and the slot it started on: the node page's **Events** draws it as a line of its own, and dates the events of another day - so does `janusctl tui`.
- `lifecycle.upgrade` says the release it installed and the one it replaced.

## 🐛 Fixes

- **`option socket-stats`**: a frontend's listeners (one row per bind in HAProxy's statistics) were listed as a backend with servers by `janusctl haproxy backends` and the node page's Backends, and as servers in `janusctl tui` - while a frontend without the option didn't show, as if it were missing. Rows are now told apart by their type: listeners and frontends never appear as backends or servers ([#64](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/issues/64)).

## 📦 Components

- **BIRD** (the BGP extension): 2.19.3 → 2.20.0. No known vulnerability fixed.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **Nodes**: the usual A/B update. The event log is kept from this release on: the update to it is the last one that starts with an empty log. The other slot is shown once the node runs this release.
- **The Controller**: update it from its update card - the Update page's version checks are the Controller's.
- **janusctl**: `apt update && apt install janusctl`, or the release's `.deb` - `version`'s other slot, and the TUI without listeners among the servers.
- **The Terraform provider**: nothing changed.

📖 Docs: [Updating nodes](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/updates.md) · [The node's API](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/api-routes.md) · [Security policy](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
